title: 5a-6: ephemeral/durable storage partition
description:
## Parent

sutra/30 (PRD: core model redesign)

## What to build

Establish the ephemeral/durable partition in the single SQLite database. Add metadata marking which tables are ephemeral (recomputable from code, droppable on reindex) vs durable (human intent, requires proper migration). Implement a reindex operation that drops only ephemeral tables and rebuilds.

Ephemeral: files, symbols, symbols_fts, refs, imports, snapshots, conventions.
Durable: convention_overrides (created in slice 7), and future tables.

Key rule: durable tables reference ephemeral data by name (qualified_name, file_path), never by integer PK.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Partition metadata: constant or table declaring each table as ephemeral or durable
- [ ] Reindex operation drops ephemeral tables, runs migrations to recreate them
- [ ] Reindex preserves durable tables and their data
- [ ] Test: reindex drops ephemeral tables, durable tables (if any exist) untouched
- [ ] Documentation: clear convention for contributors adding new tables

## Blocked by

None - can start immediately"

acceptance_criteria.text: ✅ Partition metadata declaring each table as ephemeral or durable
✅ Reindex operation drops ephemeral tables and recreates them
✅ Reindex preserves durable tables and their data
✅ Test: reindex drops ephemeral, durable untouched
✅ Documentation: clear convention for new table additions
